## The bear case

The shares trade at 24.1 times forward earnings while guided growth is about 11 percent at the midpoint. That is a full rating for a single-product story.

27.161588 million shares were sold short at the 15 August reading, and the borrow has no dated cost series. Somebody informed is paying to be against this.

- The rich rating leaves no room for a guidance miss.
- Free cash flow of 121.3 USD millions is real but already priced: the cash yield sits far under the risk-free rate of 4.21.

At 88.40 the buyer is paying today for delivery that is still two full years out.
